conventions.defect: D_r(A,B) = sum_{i<r} (A+iB)^3 - r A^3; each certificate states D_r = sum_j weights[j] * (rows[j][0] A + rows[j][1] B)^3
conventions.program: events appended after the r retained children y += a^3; a += b. a+=b k: a += k*b; b+=a k: b += k*a; y+=a^3 w: y += w*a^3; y+=b^3 w: y += w*b^3
conventions.integer-shift: PR6653 alphabet without reads of b: integer a += k*b only, queries y += q*a^3, q in Z[1/2]
conventions.general: determinant-one integer shears on a and b, dyadic queries on either named source (PR6212/PR7475 contract)
